source_frontmatter.name: pihole-csv-analyzer
source_frontmatter.description: Analyze CSV exports from Pi-hole such as query logs, top domains, top clients, or adlist exports and produce actionable recommendations. Trigger immediately when the user uploads or mentions a Pi-hole CSV file, types "pihole" or "ph analyze", or asks to analyze DNS query data, blocklist hits, or Pi-hole exports. Produce an in-chat analysis plus candidate blocklist and allowlist outputs for review.
